properties.NAME: MUSSELSHELL (orig)
properties.CHANGE: MUSSELSHELL (original) created by Montana Territory from BIG HORN (original, now CUSTER) and CHOTEAU (now CHOUTEAU). Acts of the 2d and 3d legislatures were declared null and void by the United States Congress, 2 March 1867.
properties.CITATION: (Mont. Terr. Laws 1866, 2d leg., ch. 4/p. 6; U.S. Stat., vol. 14, ch. 150 [1867], sec. 6/p. 427; Burlingame and Toole, 1:219-228; Sanders, Helen F., 1:331-341)
